facts.subject: main/melee/lb/lbcommand:.sdata2
facts.version_note: No numeric version exposed by facts query; updated_at identifies the frozen row revision.
facts.value: Command_01 reads the double constant at 0x804D79E0 while converting the current command word's low 26-bit value to floating point, then adds the converted value to CommandInfo.timer. Command_08 consumes the pool's F32_MAX literal by overwriting that timer after advancing the command cursor. The constants themselves are never mutated.
